concern_results.conclusion: Coverage-then-status ordering matches the plan's decision table row by row: covered requires moves_head=0 + clean + commit-or-tree equality, quiet requires covered + status=passed, the covered non-passed branch sets its own note/message and the uncovered assignment is guarded by [ "$covered" != 1 ] so it cannot overwrite; record_local_review in review_gate.py runs only on the fully assembled completion success result, after the failure branch has already returned.

No credential, egress, packet, or permission boundary changes; the printed receipt path is the local git-dir path the hook already computed and emits only into agent context; the controller write reuses the existing no-follow receipt writer; the reminder stays non-blocking and reads no new files.

Missing status yields "?" and reminds instead of passing; absent jq/git still degrades to silence via the hex guard and || true; a failed completion returns rc=2 before the record call leaving the receipt byte-identical; anchor sampling for complete keeps the straddle rule so a HEAD/cleanliness change mid-run records nothing.

Both changed behaviors have killing mutations: dropping the status predicate fails exactly the four status fixtures, reverting the completion write fails exactly the completion-success case; the five new hook cases are RED on the unfixed hook (26/5 split matches the fixture enumeration); failed-completion byte-identity is pinned with cmp -s.

Receipt schema unchanged; pre-change findings receipts covering HEAD now remind, which is the declared correction; existing coverage fixtures moved from hard-coded findings to default passed so they keep testing coverage rather than disposition; reminders only gain the receipt path, no consumer of the JSON output breaks.

Ships with the plugin as one commit whose revert restores prior behavior; the reminder never denies or asks so a false positive cannot block a command; no migration, state conversion, or irreversible step introduced.

All four reminder forms (no receipt, uncovered HEAD, HEAD-moving command, covered non-passed) now name the receipt path read, and the covered non-passed message carries mode, status and recorded_at so an agent opens the exact artifact instead of inferring a path mismatch.

Claims stay within the suites run; the evidence counts (unfixed 26/5, fixed 31/0, status-mutant 27/4, controller mutant failing only the completion case) are internally consistent with the fixtures; the single make test exit 2 is disclosed as a load-related abort-leak wrapper timeout with the isolated leg re-run green, not asserted as a pass, and the diff does not touch wrapper reaping.

shared-gate boundary is contained: the hook remains advisory and the controller change appends a receipt write to one existing success path without touching verdict, budget, chain, completion-success criteria, or authorization logic; a wrongly-successful complete was already possible before and the receipt now only reflects that existing conclusion.

hooks/AGENTS.md non-wording rule is met by the deterministic regression suite plus this staged review/challenge, advisory-vs-blocking stays explicit in the header, and both validation commands ran clean; skills/code-review/scripts/AGENTS.md specs-citation rule holds because the backticked specs/148-review-coverage-findings/plan.md is added in the same diff; root AGENTS.md baseline-then-RED-test, scope-control and de-sessionized-surface rules hold; no contract file is modified or loosened and no quoted rule is itself defective.
